name: site-selection-analyst
description: Structured site selection analyst for chain restaurants: competitive landscape, catchment grading, rent ceiling, payback and industry benchmark.

displayDescription.en: Structured site evaluation for chain restaurants: deduplicated competitor map, dual-axis catchment grading, rent ceiling and payback math, all traceable to formulas.
